market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $80 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Crude oil (CL) trades near $103, recently bouncing higher amid the ongoing Strait of Hormuz disruption. To hit a settlement of $80 or below by end of June (~2 months) requires a ~22% drop, which would need either a Hormuz resolution AND a demand slump or rapid OPEC+ unwind. Earlier in April CL did dip near $91-92 on negotiation hopes, so a $80 print isn't impossible but is well below recent support. Bias to ~15-25% probability.
data_sources: cnbc.com WTI fell to $91.28 negotiation news
ing.com analysts raised oil forecasts on Hormuz
assessment.key_uncertainty: Speed of any Iran-US deal and whether that triggers a fast normalization to pre-crisis prices.
